summary: Changes tax_for so it returns None for an unknown region instead of zero tax.

findings.title: None return breaks both tax_for callers
findings.problem: tax_for now returns None for an unknown region. order_total adds the result to an int, and tax_line divides it by 100.
findings.consequence: Checkout and receipt printing raise TypeError for any region outside RATES. Before this change, those regions got zero tax.
findings.fix: Keep returning 0 for an unknown region. If None is needed, update order_total and tax_line to handle it first.

findings.title: Unknown-region branch has no covering test
findings.problem: The change adds a new branch for an unknown region. The repository has no test that exercises tax_for or its callers.
findings.consequence: A test would have caught the TypeError in order_total and tax_line. Without one, later regressions in this path go unnoticed.
findings.fix: Add tests for tax_for, order_total and tax_line with a known region and an unknown region.
